senses.gloss: f. (גרר, v. גֵּרָה III) [the rugged, shrivelled,] the dry fig.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 80a:3">Sabb. 80ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 55b:5">B. Bath. 55ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Keritot 17a:21">Kerith. 17ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="C01291"><he>גרוגרות</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:28">Lam. R. to I, 11</cite> <he>כג׳</he> of the size of &c.
Y. Naz. II, beg. 51ᵈ people call לג׳ תירוש dry figs, too, tirosh (Tosaf. to Men. 103ᵃ לגרוגרות); a. e.—Pl. גְּרוֹגְרוֹת.
Naz. II, 1 if one says, I will be a Nazir abstaining from g’rog’roth, he is a Nazir; Tosef. ib. II, 1; v. כִּינּוּי.
